title: github.pull_request.create_draft v1 arguments
description: EffectDescriptor.arguments for effect_type github.pull_request.create_draft (HELM-753). The target is github.com/{owner}/{repo}; the repository comes only from the target. At Propose the gateway requires branch_attempt_id to name, in the same tenant and for the same target, a github.branch.create_from_changes attempt in OBSERVED(SUCCEEDED) whose head and base equal these and whose result commit_sha equals head_sha; otherwise PRECONDITION_FAILED and no attempt. At Dispatch the adapter re-reads refs/heads/{head} and refuses unless it still equals head_sha. Rules JSON Schema cannot express, and the gateway enforces before admission: no duplicate object keys; UTF-8 only; the whole document is at most 65536 bytes; the body is at most 65536 bytes.

branch_attempt_id.description: The github.branch.create_from_changes attempt that created head.

head_sha.description: The commit the approver's diff shows; a dispatch-time precondition.

x-helm.idempotent: conditional: one open pull request per (head, base)
x-helm.observable: yes: the pull request is read back by head and base
x-helm.reversible: yes: closing the pull request (not part of v1)
x-helm.approval: required by mandate policy for this effect type; not step-up (step-up is for high or irreversible effects, §10.1)
